title: The Admin page's Control tab: stop live model calls, a monthly cap, resume paused models, stop every job, and the machine's state
request: The owner asked for a control panel for the owner only.
spec: Two switches kept in the workspace (live model calls, a monthly euro cap) that the live-model guard and the gateway read, an environment setting winning; a status of spend against the cap, jobs, disk, swap, the store job and the last bench run; resume paused models; stop every job; the dangerous actions confirmed with the Admin password; every change audited.
plan: the switches in a workspace file
the guard and the gateway read them
the routes with the password asked again

decisions.decision: An environment setting wins over a switch
decisions.why: a deployment or a test pins what it pins; the page shows when a switch is overruled

decisions.decision: A model on this machine is never stopped by the live switch
decisions.why: the switch is about paid providers; local models cost nothing

decisions.decision: The password asked again goes through the same check and lock as a sign-in
decisions.why: a confirm step that does not count wrong passwords would be a way around the lock

change: dclab_rnd/control.py and agentic/pages/control.py (new); models/live_guard.py, models/gateway.py (read the switches); accounts/admin_login.py (confirm); accounts/guard.py (owner-only routes); agentic/pages/__init__.py; views/admin.html (the Control tab), the generated app; CLAUDE.md; tests/test_control.py, tests/test_experience_log.py.

findings.defect: New write routes must say what they record
findings.scenario: the three control routes were added
findings.cause: the experience test lists every write route
findings.fix: the routes are listed as audited owner actions

findings.defect: Stopping live models did not stop a client that already existed
findings.scenario: an intern session sent one request, the owner turned calls off, and every later request still reached the provider
findings.cause: the switch was checked only when a provider client was first built
findings.fix: the gateway checks the switch of its own workspace before every request; a model on this machine is never stopped

findings.defect: The switch was written in the request's workspace and read from the default one
findings.scenario: with several workspaces a switch in one did nothing there and the default one's stopped all; pressing Stop on the owner's server made the test suite fail
findings.cause: the guard read the switch without a workspace
findings.fix: the switch is read by the gateway with its own workspace; the guard keeps only its environment rules

findings.defect: The text false left models on with no error
findings.scenario: a request sending the text false as the switch answered ok and changed nothing
findings.cause: the value was turned into a flag by truth, and any non-empty text is true
findings.fix: only a real true or false is accepted; anything else is refused

findings.defect: Stop every job counted every job and could fail
findings.scenario: a job already asked to stop was counted again; a job ending between the list and the stop made the route fail
findings.cause: the job store returns the job, which is always true, and raises when the job is gone
findings.fix: only jobs this call changed are counted; a job that ended meanwhile is skipped

measurements.name: the switches and routes
measurements.result: a stopped switch refuses a paid provider and lets a local model through; the environment cap wins; a wrong password is refused and audited; a right one changes the switch
limits: the paused-model count is this process's only, without PostgreSQL

outcome: The owner can stop paid model calls, cap the month, resume paused models and stop every job from one tab, with each change audited.
lessons: a switch that lives only in .env is a switch nobody flips in time
risks: stopping every job also stops the nightly work that runs as jobs
